mapper.insert: insert into estimate_info (estimate_id, `name`, `desc`, logo, topo_id, estimate_scheme_id, user_id, create_time, update_time) values (#{estimateId}, #{name}, #{desc}, #{logo}, #{topoId}, #{estimateSchemeId}, #{userId}, now(), now())
mapper.select: select count(id) from estimate_info where user_id = #{userId}
